name: uccif
description: Install once, then in any repository: CodeGraph setup (code graph for Claude via MCP), project skills generated from the graph, LSP config, task memory, token reporting, project docs with drift detection, and a token-saving workflow. Never blocks.

reply_language.title: Reply language
reply_language.description: Language Claude uses when replying to you (framework files stay English). Example: vi, en.

token_report.title: Token line after each turn
token_report.description: Show one line with real token usage (read from the transcript) after each reply.

auto_setup.title: Automatic project setup
auto_setup.description: When the CodeGraph CLI is installed: index each project in the background (codegraph init) and write project skills (.claude/skills/<project>-map, -bugfix, -mod-*) from the index, refreshed when the structure changes.

strict_codegraph.title: Strict CodeGraph-first
strict_codegraph.description: When CodeGraph is indexed: refuse the first Read/Grep of source code in a turn that has no CodeGraph lookup yet, with the call to make instead (a retry is allowed). Off: a reminder only.
